pageDescription: Goals, reviews and skills — how work is planned, judged and recorded.

workspace.noEmployeeLink: Your account isn't linked to an employee record, so there is nothing personal to show here. Ask HR to link your account.

goals.title: Goals
goals.description: What each person is working toward — drafts become active, then complete.
goals.denied: You don't have permission to view these goals.
goals.empty: No goals yet. Create a goal to start tracking progress.
goals.emptyFiltered: No goals match these filters. Clear a filter or choose another status.
goals.swipe: Swipe sideways to see every goal field.
goals.label: Goals
goals.containerLabel: Goals. Scroll horizontally to read all columns.

goalForm.createDescription: Create a goal in draft, then activate it when work starts.
goalForm.editDescription: Update the goal while it is a draft or active. Completing or cancelling is a separate, terminal action.
goalForm.employeeHint: The person this goal belongs to. It can't change after creation.
goalForm.title: Goal
goalForm.descriptionHint: Sensitive: visible to the employee, their manager and HR, never included in events.
goalForm.descriptionPlaceholder: What success looks like and the first concrete step.
goalForm.dueDateHint: Past dates are allowed — goals are plans, not claims.
goalForm.progressHint: 0–100. Completing a goal never changes progress automatically.

goalState.activateDescription: Activate “{title}”? The employee can then record progress until the goal completes or is cancelled.
goalState.completeDescription: Complete “{title}”? This is terminal — a completed goal can't be edited or re-opened.
goalState.cancelDescription: Cancel “{title}”? This is terminal — the goal can't be re-opened. Progress stays as recorded.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.description: Completed reviews and the ones still in progress.
reviews.myDescription: Your completed reviews. Drafts stay with your manager until they are finished.
reviews.denied: You don't have permission to view these reviews.
reviews.empty: No reviews yet. A review appears here after a manager starts one.
reviews.emptyFiltered: No reviews match these filters. Clear a filter or choose another status.
reviews.emptyMine: No completed reviews yet. Your manager's drafts stay hidden until they finish.
reviews.swipe: Swipe sideways to see every review field.
reviews.label: Reviews
reviews.containerLabel: Reviews. Scroll horizontally to read all columns.

detail.title: Review details
detail.draftNotice: This review is a draft — the employee sees it only after it is completed.

form.createDescription: Start a review for a team member, nominate peers for input, then add the rating and complete it when it is ready.
form.editDescription: Update the draft while it stays private to you and HR. Completing publishes it to the employee and is final.
form.employeeHint: The person being reviewed. It can't change after creation, and you can never review yourself.
form.periodHint: A short label such as 2026-H1. It appears on the employee's completed review.
form.ratingHint: 1 to 5. A rating is required before the review can be completed.
form.strengthsHint: Sensitive: the employee sees this on the completed review, never in events.
form.strengthsPlaceholder: What the employee did well this period.
form.improvementsHint: Sensitive: the employee sees this on the completed review, never in events.
form.improvementsPlaceholder: Where to focus next and how.
form.providersHint: Nominate up to 10 active employees other than the employee and yourself. They file one comment each while the review is a draft.
form.providersEmpty: No eligible peers are in your directory.

state.completeDescription: Complete the review for {name}? A rating is required, and a completed review can't be edited.
state.cancelDescription: Cancel the review for {name}? Draft feedback stays readable to you and HR, but no further feedback is accepted.

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.description: Peer input on a review, visible to the review author and HR.

worklist.title: Feedback requested
worklist.description: Reviews where you were nominated as a peer. Submit one comment while the review is still a draft — it can't be edited afterward.
worklist.swipe: Swipe sideways to see every field.
worklist.label: Feedback requested
worklist.containerLabel: Feedback requested. Scroll horizontally to read all columns.
worklist.submitAria: Give feedback on the review for {name}

form.title: Give feedback
form.description: Your comment on the review for {name}. The review author and HR can read it; the employee never does.
form.commentHint: Sensitive: visible to the review author and HR only. One submission per review, final once sent.
form.commentPlaceholder: What should the reviewer know about this person's work?
form.denied: You're no longer nominated for this review, so it can't accept your feedback.

panel.title: Peer feedback
panel.description: Comments from the peers nominated for this review.
panel.denied: Feedback is visible to the review author and HR only.
panel.empty: No peer has filed feedback on this review yet.

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: The tenant skill catalog. Employee skills build on it.
skills.denied: You don't have permission to view the skill catalog.
skills.empty: No skills in the catalog yet.
skills.emptyFiltered: No skills match this search. Clear the search or show archived skills.
skills.swipe: Swipe sideways to see every skill field.
skills.label: Skills
skills.containerLabel: Skills. Scroll horizontally to read all columns.

form.createDescription: Add a skill to the tenant catalog. Employees can then be recorded at a proficiency from 1 to 5.
form.editDescription: Rename or re-describe the skill. The name stays unique across active and archived rows.
form.name: Skill
form.nameHint: Up to 100 characters. Archived names stay reserved.
form.descriptionHint: Sensitive: the catalog description is visible to every employee, never included in events.
form.descriptionPlaceholder: What this skill covers in practice.

state.archiveDescription: Archive “{name}”? It leaves the catalog and pickers, but employees who already have it keep it and can still update their level.
state.restoreDescription: Restore “{name}” to the catalog and the attach picker?

employee.title: Employee skills
employee.description: A person's current skills and proficiency, recorded from the catalog.
employee.loadError: Could not load these employee skills.
employee.empty: No skills are recorded for {name} yet.
employee.chooseEmployee: Choose an employee to see their skills.
employee.noCatalog: Add an active catalog skill first — archived skills can't be newly assigned.
employee.swipe: Swipe sideways to see every skill field.
employee.label: Employee skills
employee.containerLabel: Employee skills. Scroll horizontally to read all columns.

employeeForm.createDescription: Record a skill for {name} from the active catalog.
employeeForm.editDescription: Update {name}'s proficiency and note. Archived skills stay editable here.
employeeForm.skillHint: Only active catalog skills can be newly attached.
employeeForm.noteHint: Sensitive: visible to the employee, their manager and HR, never included in events.
employeeForm.notePlaceholder: Where this skill shows up in their work.

employeeRemove.title: Remove skill
employeeRemove.description: Remove {skill} from {name}? This can't be undone; the employee can be given the skill again later.

errors.goalNotFound: This goal is no longer available.
errors.goalNotDraft: Only a draft goal can be activated. Refresh the list and try again.
errors.goalNotActive: Only an active goal can be completed. Refresh the list and try again.
errors.goalTerminal: This goal is completed or cancelled and can no longer change.
errors.reviewNotFound: This review is no longer available.
errors.reviewIncomplete: Add a rating before completing the review.
errors.reviewNotDraft: This review is no longer a draft. Refresh the list and try again.
errors.feedbackProviderInvalid: Choose active employees other than the reviewer and the employee being reviewed.
errors.feedbackAlreadySubmitted: You already submitted feedback for this review.
errors.feedbackAccessDenied: Feedback is visible to the review author and HR only.
errors.skillNameTaken: A skill with this name already exists, including archived skills.
errors.skillArchived: This skill is archived and can't be assigned to anyone new.
errors.employeeSkillExists: This employee already has this skill. Update the existing row instead.
errors.employeeNotActive: That employee is no longer active and can't be given new goals or reviews.
errors.employeeNotFound: Choose an employee from your organization.
errors.skillNotFound: This skill is no longer available.
errors.denied: You don't have permission to manage performance.
errors.validation: Check the highlighted fields and try again.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
errors.notFound: This item is no longer available.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

validation.titleTooLong: Goal title must be at most 200 characters
validation.descriptionTooLong: Description must be at most 2,000 characters
validation.progressInt: Progress must be a whole number
validation.periodTooLong: Period must be at most 50 characters
validation.strengthsTooLong: Strengths must be at most 2,000 characters
validation.improvementsTooLong: Improvements must be at most 2,000 characters
validation.commentTooLong: Comment must be at most 2,000 characters
validation.skillNameTooLong: Skill name must be at most 100 characters
validation.skillDescriptionTooLong: Skill description must be at most 500 characters
validation.noteTooLong: Note must be at most 500 characters
